settings.text: A few things worth knowing before the bottle reaches your shower.

settings.question: Does fragrance-free mean it has no smell?
settings.answer: We add no perfume or essential oils to Calm wash. You may notice a faint scent from the ingredients themselves.

settings.question: Can I use it if I have an oat allergy?
settings.answer: Calm wash contains colloidal oat. Check the full ingredient list against your known allergies, and ask your healthcare professional if you are unsure.

settings.question: How is Rich wash different?
settings.answer: Rich wash has extra shea butter and oat oil, with a thicker, almost lotion-like feel. Calm wash is the everyday starting point.
settings.quick_line: Very dry or winter skin. Thicker, almost a lotion.
settings.quick_ing: Calm wash plus extra shea butter and oat oil. Fragrance-free. pH 5.5.

settings.question: What if my skin reacts?
settings.answer: Stop using it and contact us. We refund your first bottle, used or not. Read the skin-reaction refund details.
